definitions.explanation: The ability to bear difficulty, pain, or annoyance without complaining.

examples.japanese: もう{我慢|がまん}できない！
{痛|いた}みを{我慢|がまん}する。
もう{少|すこ}し{我慢|がまん}してください。
examples.english: Please be patient a little longer.

notes:
{我慢|がまん} is a valued trait in Japanese culture.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {我慢|がまん}する (to endure, be patient)
- {我慢|がまん}できる/できない (can/cannot endure)
- {我慢|がまん}{強|づよ}い (patient, persevering)

Related: {忍耐|にんたい} (patience - more formal), {辛抱|しんぼう} (patience, perseverance)
